plugins.name: sessions
plugins.description: Side panel with this folder's Claude Code sessions: status colors, sections, one-window switching, stop, restart, rename, a waiting-for-you filter, auto-pin and reopen with Remote Control, a notification when a session waits too long or spends far above its usual, spend and token usage, a status line, ccc tell and ccc section for scripts, and an API for other plugins

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Per project: a roster of permanent background sessions started with /fleet up from a template, each seeded, budgeted, paced and placed in the panel; they ask you without stopping and you answer from any session with /fleet, at no token cost; nothing leaves to a third party without your approval of the exact draft; the charter, roster and requirements change only when you apply a drafted change or ask for it yourself in a clean session; a stale write of a shared file is refused once; records cited by version turn their citers suspect when revised; mail and chat read once each as data and routed by tags; alerts by push, a mail to yourself or a script; derived documents kept current; scarce resources taken in turn; judges propose from your past answers (shadow); /fleet brief. Needs sessions
